s: Additionally, existing competitors may consolidate with other retailers, expand their merchandise offerings, expand their e-commerce capabilities, and/or add new sales channels, change their pricing strategies, or use technology more effectively than we do, including the use of artificial intelligence.
Moreover, the rapid evolution and increased adoption of artificial intelligence technologies may intensify our cybersecurity risks.

Moreover, the rapid evolution and increased adoption of artificial intelligence, Software as a Service (SaaS) and cloud technologies may intensify our cybersecurity risks.

Additionally, existing competitors may consolidate with other retailers, expand their merchandise offerings, expand their e-commerce capabilities, and/or add new sales channels, change their pricing strategies, or use technology more effectively than we do, including the use of artificial intelligence (“AI”) or other emerging technologies.

Hardware, software or applications (including AI capabilities) we develop or obtain from third parties may contain defects in design or manufacture or other problems that are not presently known and could unexpectedly compromise information security.

Moreover, the rapid evolution and increased adoption of artificial intelligence, machine learning, Software as a Service (SaaS), and cloud technologies may intensify our cybersecurity risks, especially as threat actors use AI to enhance attacks that are harder to detect and defend against.
